svg.title: How a check of the app that fails explains itself
svg.desc: A check of the app fails, such as the end-to-end tests, the contract tests against Paperless, the package or a check of scripts/check-project.sh. Its job explains the failure from .github/checks.project.toml, in its summary and as its annotation, and the CI runs the commands that fix what a command can. After the checks, the PR coach keeps one comment on the pull request with the explanation of each check that failed, also on a pull request from a fork, and the fix bot commits the fixes onto a branch of this repository or suggests them at their lines on a fork. You fix the rest with the commands that the explanation names and push, and the checks run again, as they do after a commit of the fix bot. You are orange, the checks and the bots blue, and the explanations and the new run green.
